title: A Day at the Playground
text:
Tom likes the playground. It is big and green. In spring, the flowers are pretty and the sun is warm. Tom plays on the swings with his friend Ali.

In winter, the playground is cold and white with snow. Tom wears a red hat and warm gloves. He builds a big snowman with Ali. In summer, Tom likes to play in the shade under the tree.

questions.text: What does Tom play on with his friend Ali?
What does Tom wear in winter?
options: A red hat and warm gloves

questions.text: Why does Tom wear a red hat and warm gloves in winter?
How does Tom probably feel when he builds a snowman with Ali?

vocabulary.definition: a place outside where children play
seats hung from a frame that children sit on and move back and forth
a figure made of snow, shaped like a person
a cool, dark place where the sun does not reach

paragraph_translations: Tom oyun alanını sever. Büyük ve yeşildir. İlkbaharda çiçekler güzel ve güneş sıcaktır. Tom arkadaşı Ali ile salıncaklarda oynar.
Kışın oyun alanı karla kaplı, soğuk ve beyazdır. Tom kırmızı bir şapka ve sıcak eldiven takar. Ali ile büyük bir kardan adam yapar. Yazın Tom ağacın altındaki gölgede oynamayı sever.
